title: Trump Clears Foreign Shipyards to Build US Navy Warships
detail: The Trump administration authorized foreign shipyards — including those in India, South Korea, and Japan — to build US Navy warships, marking a significant break from longstanding US naval procurement policy. The move has strategic implications for key allies and represents a major shift in how the Pentagon can source military vessels.
